confidence.definition: How likely an identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct, as the producing software reports it.

values.pep: Posterior error probability: the probability that this single identification is wrong; lower is better.
values.q_value: The smallest false discovery rate at which this identification, or quantified signal, is accepted; lower is better.

values.identification: Whether the level's entity is correctly identified.
values.quantification: Whether the signal quantified for it, such as its MS1 peak, belongs to it.

miape.definition: A field of the MIAPE-AnnData 0.4.0 draft schema that a retained APB field supplies, on the matching modality: protein level to protein group, peptide to peptide, peptidoform to peptidoform.

kind.definition: The MIAPE-AnnData field name; the requirement level is the schema's.

values.protein_group: var, MUST: protein-group identifier as semicolon-separated UniProt accessions; on peptide and peptidoform levels the foreign key to the protein modality.
values.gene_name: var, SHOULD: gene symbol of the protein group.
values.organism: var, SHOULD: species of the protein group.
values.protein_description: var, MAY: free-text protein description, typically the UniProt protein name.
values.n_peptides_used: var, SHOULD: distinct peptide sequences aggregated into the protein group.
values.is_contaminant: var, SHOULD: whether the protein group comes from a contaminant database.
values.sequence: var, MUST: bare amino-acid sequence without modifications or charge.
values.is_unique: var, MUST: whether the peptide or peptidoform maps to exactly one protein group.
values.n_psms: var, MAY: peptide-spectrum matches aggregated into the row across all samples.
values.raw: layers, MUST: the unmodified engine-output quantification matrix.
